sample_unit: reference intervals (from 726,000 chatbot requests across 47 laboratory parameters)

links.outcome: Repeatability (coefficient of variation) of LLM-generated reference intervals across repeated identical prompts
links.effect: Mean CV 26.50% (IQR 7.35-129.01%) for lower limit and 15.82% (IQR 4.50-45.30%) for upper limit; GPT-4 and GPT-4o had significantly lower CVs than GPT-3.5-Turbo.
links.quote: On average, the chatbots exhibited a CV of 26.50% (IQR: 7.35-129.01%) for the lower limit and 15.82% (IQR: 4.50-45.30%) for the upper limit upon repetition.

unlisted_practices: Mandatory inclusion of reference intervals in prompts so chatbots do not generate them
Training chatbots to refuse laboratory interpretation when reference intervals are not provided
Global harmonization of laboratory standards to reduce variability in AI outputs

screen.reason: Evaluates the consistency/repeatability of reference interval generation across versions of ChatGPT without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
